svg.title: About Montaser
svg.desc: Montaser is a cybersecurity student at Applied Science University in Amman, Jordan, and a student at 42 Amman. His main interests are C programming, Linux, networking, and the security of the systems that connect them. His projects include a Unix shell, concurrent programs, and network configuration exercises. He also runs a self-built Debian home server, using it to explore infrastructure and system security beyond the classroom. He is building toward a career where systems programming and cybersecurity meet. Away from the terminal, Montaser plays chess and guitar and holds a diploma in Fine Arts (guitar).
